caption: The drawing shows two primary objects: a banknote and a ribbon or badge, both depicted in a realistic style with pencil and watercolor shading. The upper object is a Virginia Treasury Note with a denomination of one dollar, rendered in a mostly grayish color with prominent red "1" numerals in both upper corners, and the word "ONE" painted in red across the center. There is black printed and handwritten text, as well as illustrated vignettes: a small portrait of a man on the left, and a classical figure holding a shield and staff in the center, with surrounding ornamental designs. Below and partly overlapping the banknote is a beige-colored fabric ribbon or badge with fringed edges at the bottom, attached to the note by a metallic ring and a pin or clasp. The ribbon has handwritten or painted red text in a decorative style: “Dixie 1861-1865 Philadelphia 07. B.P.O.E. 867 Winchester Va.” arranged in a vertical format, with decorative dashes between and around the words. The drawing is set on an off-white background.
title: $1 Banknote from Virginia
